answer: Every answer enters a terrace of sealed transcripts, and validators run a random audit: each epoch, chain re-draws 3 past answers per agent, attaches fresh nonce, and forces replay of full reasoning. An agent holding one honest identity passes cheaply, but forged personas must each re-derive consistent logic on demand, their falsehoods surfacing as a spiral of mismatched traces. Failure slashes 500 bonded tokens (about $340) and drops seat weight to zero. Faking 1,000 identities now means funding 3,000 replays, a voyage from anonymity to ruin at roughly $1.02M locked capital.
